note: Derived read-only snapshot. Example clarity is independent of runtime support; these are not parser tests.

controls.name: File Picker
controls.purpose: Select existing documents and media from folders or accessible file sources.
controls.rule: Confirm the file you want to use; a name in the request alone is not an attachment.

cases.zh: 用电脑桌面上的产品照片做参考。
cases.en: Use the product photo on my computer desktop as a reference.

cases.zh: 把下载文件夹里的演示视频加进来。
cases.en: Add the demo video from my downloads folder.

cases.zh: 从预算文件夹选一份Excel预算表，汇总成CSV。
cases.en: Pick an Excel budget sheet from the budget folder and summarize it as a CSV.

cases.zh: 把项目文件夹里的访谈录音加进来。
cases.en: Add the interview recording from the project folder.

cases.zh: 从下载文件夹找一份PDF合同，帮我看下条款。
cases.en: Find a PDF contract in my downloads folder and review the terms.

cases.zh: 用项目文件夹里的销售表看看各季度的趋势。
cases.en: Use the sales spreadsheet in the project folder to look at quarterly trends.

cases.zh: 把电脑桌面上的旁白录音加进来，做视频配音。
cases.en: Add the narration recording from my computer desktop for the video voice-over.

cases.zh: 项目文件夹里有张首页布局草图，做网页时参考一下。
cases.en: There is a homepage layout sketch in the project folder. Use it for the website.

cases.zh: 从下载文件夹找份Word访谈记录，帮我归纳用户需求。
cases.en: Find a Word interview transcript in my downloads folder and summarize user needs.

cases.zh: 做这个App时，参考工程文件夹里的需求文档。
cases.en: Use the requirements document in the project folder when building this App.

cases.zh: 参考上次那份产品资料。
cases.en: Refer to the product brief from last time.

cases.zh: 把刚才说的那几个表加进来。
cases.en: Add those tables we just discussed.

cases.zh: 用小艺知识库里那份竞品报告。
cases.en: Use that competitor report in the Xiaoyi Knowledge Base.

cases.zh: 电脑里之前存的那份产品资料，找出来参考一下。
cases.en: Find the product brief I saved on my computer before and use it as a reference.

cases.zh: 找一下之前用于预算的那个表格。
cases.en: Find the spreadsheet we used for the budget before.

cases.zh: 电脑里攒了不少资料，这次报告不想再从零开始。
cases.en: I have plenty of material saved on my computer. I do not want to start this report from scratch.

cases.zh: 以前好像整理过类似内容。
cases.en: I think we organized something similar before.

cases.zh: 这份方案缺点依据，电脑里存的资料应该能派上用场。
cases.en: This proposal needs more evidence. The material saved on my computer might help.

cases.zh: 做这个App时用上我们已有的东西。
cases.en: Use what we already have when making this App.

cases.zh: 我记得这些信息可能已经整理过。
cases.en: I think this information may have been organized already.

cases.zh: 从相册选两张产品照片。
cases.en: Select two product photos from the gallery.

cases.zh: 现在拍一张产品照片给你参考。
cases.en: I will take a product photo now for reference.

cases.zh: 把结果保存为PDF。
cases.en: Save the result as a PDF.

cases.zh: 生成一段产品演示视频。
cases.en: Generate a product demo video.

cases.zh: 把结果保存成一个文件。
cases.en: Save the result as a file.

controls.name: Media Gallery
controls.purpose: Choose existing photos and videos to add to the task.
controls.rule: Confirm the chosen items to attach them. Opening the picker does not select or send anything.

cases.zh: 我有一些产品图片需要参考。
cases.en: I have some product images I want to use as references.

cases.zh: 把昨天拍好的产品演示视频加进来。
cases.en: Add the product demo video I filmed yesterday.

cases.zh: 我有几张产品照片，要放在文档里。
cases.en: I have a few product photos I want to put in the document.

cases.zh: 从相册选张手绘草图，做App时参考一下。
cases.en: Pick a hand-drawn sketch from my gallery as a reference for the App.

cases.zh: 开会拍的白板照片还在，拿来整理一下结论。
cases.en: I still have the whiteboard photo from the meeting. Use it to summarize the conclusions.

cases.zh: 用之前拍好的门店视频看看顾客怎么走。
cases.en: Use the store video I filmed earlier to see how customers move around.

cases.zh: 报销要用的收据照片我已经拍好了，帮我加进去。
cases.en: I have already photographed the receipts for my expenses. Add the photos.

cases.zh: 我存了三张包装图，放一起比较一下设计。
cases.en: I saved three packaging images. Put them together to compare the designs.

cases.zh: 从相册选登录页面截图，作为App改版参考。
cases.en: Choose the login screenshot from the gallery as an App redesign reference.

cases.zh: 我这儿有段采访视频，帮我提炼一下产品反馈。
cases.en: I have an interview video. Help me pull out the product feedback.

cases.zh: 把刚才那张照片放上去。
cases.en: Add that photo from a moment ago.

cases.zh: 插入上次那段视频。
cases.en: Add that video from last time.

cases.zh: 给这个App加一张参考图。
cases.en: Add a reference image for this App.

cases.zh: 用手机里那个视频。
cases.en: Use that video on my phone.

cases.zh: 封面就用上次挑的那张。
cases.en: Use the one we picked last time for the cover.

cases.zh: 我已经拍了些产品细节照片，想让客户看得更明白。
cases.en: I have already taken some product-detail photos. I want customers to understand the product better.

cases.zh: 这份文档全是文字，想穿插些产品照片。
cases.en: This document is all text. I would like some product photos throughout it.

cases.zh: 网站想用一些真实的使用场景照片，别全是文字。
cases.en: I want photos of real use cases on the website, not just text.

cases.zh: 前后效果想用照片对比，光写文字不太直观。
cases.en: I want photos to compare the before-and-after results. Text alone is hard to picture.

cases.zh: 这款产品的几种用法，想用图片让人一眼看懂。
cases.en: I want pictures that show the different ways to use this product at a glance.

cases.zh: 用电脑桌面上的产品照片。
cases.en: Use the product photo on my computer desktop.

cases.zh: 打开相机拍一下样机。
cases.en: Open the camera so I can photograph the prototype.

cases.zh: 生成一张产品照片。
cases.en: Generate a product photo.

cases.zh: 录下现在的屏幕操作。
cases.en: Record the current screen interaction.

cases.zh: 现在拍一段产品视频。
cases.en: Film a product video now.

controls.name: Photo / Document Scan
controls.purpose: Photograph objects or scan paper pages and sketches, then review and attach them.
controls.rule: Choose Photo for an object or scene; choose Scan for a paper page.

cases.zh: 我把产品侧面照下来给你，帮我看看接口。
cases.en: I will take a photo of the product's side for you. Help me check the ports.

cases.zh: 打开相机，我把会议室现在的布置照给你看。
cases.en: Open the camera. I will take a photo of the room's current setup for you.

cases.zh: 这些手写笔记和便签作参考，帮我整理会议结论。
cases.en: Use these handwritten notes and sticky notes to summarize the meeting conclusions.

cases.zh: 纸上已经有角色动作草图了，用这张。
cases.en: The character-pose sketch is already on paper. Use this one.

cases.zh: 我这张手绘草图给你作参考，照这个做产品图。
cases.en: Use my hand-drawn sketch as a reference to make the product image.

cases.zh: 按纸上这张手绘流程图，帮我写操作说明。
cases.en: Use this hand-drawn flowchart on paper to write the instructions.

cases.zh: 这份手写试卷给你看看，帮我讲讲错题。
cases.en: Take a look at this handwritten exam paper and explain the answers I got wrong.

cases.zh: 把打印稿上的手写批注带上，一起参考。
cases.en: Include the handwritten comments on the printout as a reference too.

cases.zh: 帮我调出相机，我把设备铭牌照给你看。
cases.en: Bring up the camera so I can show you a photo of the equipment label.

cases.zh: 打开相机，录一段产品演示给你参考。
cases.en: Open the camera and record a product demo video for reference.

cases.zh: 手写笔记给你参考一下。
cases.en: Use the handwritten notes as a reference.

cases.zh: 这张纸上的内容我想录下来给你。
cases.en: I want to record what is on this sheet of paper for you.

cases.zh: 把我那张手绘草图用上。
cases.en: Use my hand-drawn sketch.

cases.zh: 这个设备的异常，我录下来给你还是照张图？
cases.en: Should I record a video of the equipment problem or take a photo for you?

cases.zh: 我想给你看它怎么运转，弄段视频过来。
cases.en: I want to show you how it runs. Let me get you a video.

cases.zh: 这个实物的质感用文字说不清。
cases.en: The texture of this object is hard to describe in words.

cases.zh: 现在这个展台怎么摆的，光说你可能想象不出来。
cases.en: You might not be able to picture this display setup from words alone.

cases.zh: 这几页手写试卷，想弄清楚自己老错在哪。
cases.en: I want to understand my recurring mistakes in these handwritten exam pages.

cases.zh: 这些手写便签最好能整理成一份待办。
cases.en: I would like to turn these handwritten sticky notes into a to-do list.

cases.zh: 纸上这些手写批注，我不想对着电脑再抄一遍。
cases.en: I do not want to retype these handwritten comments from the paper into my computer.

cases.zh: 只用我上传的包装照片，不用再拍。
cases.en: Use only the packaging photo I uploaded; do not take another.

cases.zh: 从相册选那张产品侧面照片。
cases.en: Choose the product side-view photo from the gallery.

cases.zh: 录下我在屏幕上操作的过程。
cases.en: Record the steps I perform on the screen.

cases.zh: 分析我刚传上来的那份扫描合同。
cases.en: Analyze the scanned contract I just uploaded.

cases.zh: 我还没画流程图，想现在手绘一张给你。
cases.en: I have not drawn the flowchart yet. I want to sketch one for you now.

controls.name: Sketchpad
controls.purpose: Draw a sketch to explain shapes, layouts or relationships for the task.
controls.rule: Drawing is optional: keep the written description, or add a sketch to make it clearer.

cases.zh: 我画个猫的轮廓，照这个生成插画。
cases.en: I will sketch a cat outline. Use it to make an illustration.

cases.zh: 我来新画一张App页面关系草图。
cases.en: Let me draw a new rough sketch of how the App screens connect.

cases.zh: 产品剖面我手绘一下，再帮我解释结构。
cases.en: Let me sketch the product cross-section, then help me explain its structure.

cases.zh: 先给你个操作流程示意，我现在勾出来。
cases.en: Let me sketch out the workflow for you first.

cases.zh: 网页左边放文字，右边放图片。
cases.en: Put the text on the left and the image on the right of the webpage.

cases.zh: 我想在这张照片上圈出要改的地方。 ‡
cases.en: I want to circle the areas I would like changed on this photo. ‡

cases.zh: 我想先搭个数据库关系草图。
cases.en: I want to rough out a sketch of the database relationships first.

cases.zh: 桌子靠左墙，沙发放右边，中间留条过道。
cases.en: Put the desk against the left wall and the sofa on the right. Leave a walkway between them.

cases.zh: 镜头里产品居中，文字留在右上角。
cases.en: Center the product in the shot and leave room for text at the top right.

cases.zh: 电源在上面，两块主板并排，线从下面走。
cases.en: Put the power supply above the two side-by-side boards, with the cables below.

cases.zh: 还没画，我想先把它的大概形状弄出来。
cases.en: Nothing is drawn yet. I want to work out its rough shape first.

cases.zh: 我想先给你个示意，手头还没有图。
cases.en: I want to give you a rough visual reference first, but I do not have one yet.

cases.zh: 这个结构我想比划一下给你看。
cases.en: Let me roughly show you how this structure goes.

cases.zh: 这个布局我想自己试着摆一摆。
cases.en: I want to try arranging this layout myself.

cases.zh: 先把这几个关系理成图吧，现在还没有。
cases.en: Let's map out these relationships first; there is no diagram yet.

cases.zh: 我脑子里有个样子，但说不出来。
cases.en: I have a rough picture in mind but cannot describe it.

cases.zh: 这几个页面怎么跳转我心里有谱，还没画成图，光说不明白。
cases.en: I know how these screens should link up, but I have no diagram and cannot explain it in words.

cases.zh: 流程的几个分叉都在我脑子里，还没画出来，光说容易绕。
cases.en: The workflow branches are still in my head, not drawn yet, and hard to explain in words.

cases.zh: 产品内部结构我有个想法，还没图，打字跟你讲不清。
cases.en: I have an idea for the product's internal structure, but no diagram, and cannot explain it in text.

cases.zh: 这个形状太难用文字说明了。
cases.en: This shape is too hard to explain in words.

cases.zh: 直接生成流程图，不用我补草图。
cases.en: Generate the flowchart directly; I do not need to add a sketch.

cases.zh: 用我已经上传的那张草图。
cases.en: Use the sketch I already uploaded.

cases.zh: 解释一下什么是手绘草图。
cases.en: Explain what a hand-drawn sketch is.

cases.zh: 纸上已经有角色动作草图了，用这张。
cases.en: The character-pose sketch is already on paper. Use this one.

cases.zh: 把网页背景改成手绘风格。
cases.en: Give the webpage background a hand-drawn style.

controls.name: Color
controls.purpose: Specify one object’s color, such as a button, title, icon, line or product part.
controls.rule: A known swatch can be used by default. An unresolved color description remains a choice to make.

cases.zh: 把App的主按钮设成#000000。
cases.en: Set the App's main button to #000000.

cases.zh: 按钮用红色，深深的红。
cases.en: Make the button red, a really deep red.
Use RGB 245,245,245 for the divider line.

cases.zh: 浅浅的灰。
cases.en: A really light gray.

cases.zh: 生成一张红色跑车的照片。
cases.en: Generate a photo of a red sports car.

cases.zh: 标题用 TIFFINY 蓝。
cases.en: Use TIFFINY blue for the title.

cases.zh: 杯子奶油白。
cases.en: Creamy white for the cup.

cases.zh: 像橄榄那样的绿。
cases.en: Green like an olive.

cases.zh: 蓝一点点，别发紫。
cases.en: A tiny bit bluer; do not let it turn purple.

cases.zh: 还是刚才选中的那块蓝。
cases.en: Still the blue swatch selected just now.

cases.zh: 这个图标的颜色再深一点。
cases.en: Make this icon’s color a little darker.

cases.zh: 换成那个红。
cases.en: Change it to that red.

cases.zh: 这里的文字颜色换成莫兰迪那种。
cases.en: Give the text here that muted Morandi kind of color.

cases.zh: 这个标题的颜色按我们品牌来。
cases.en: Use our brand color for this title.

cases.zh: 按钮的颜色换成刚才看过的那种。
cases.en: Change the button color to the one we looked at earlier.

cases.zh: 生物科普页面的主按钮，要有植物生长的感觉。
cases.en: The main button on the biology page should suggest plants and growth.

cases.zh: 科技展的标题，要有未来感。
cases.en: Give the technology exhibition title a futuristic feel.

cases.zh: 活动海报的报名按钮，要让人觉得热情、有活力。
cases.en: Make the sign-up button on the event poster feel warm and energetic.

cases.zh: 海洋科普里的海豚图标，想要清爽、宁静的感觉。
cases.en: Give the dolphin icon in the ocean guide a fresh, peaceful feel.

cases.zh: 婴儿护理产品的瓶盖，要有柔软、温和的感觉。
cases.en: Give the baby-care product’s bottle cap a soft, gentle feel.

cases.zh: App名字叫Red Ledger。
cases.en: Name the App Red Ledger.

cases.zh: 分析红色系列产品的销售额。
cases.en: Analyze sales of the red product range.

cases.zh: 别改颜色，只修复登录按钮。
cases.en: Keep the colors; just fix the login button.

cases.zh: 统计比赛中的红牌次数。
cases.en: Count the red cards in the match.

cases.zh: 给报告起名叫“蓝色计划”。
cases.en: Name the report Blue Plan.

controls.name: Time
controls.purpose: Specify a duration or duration limit for the task or its output.
controls.rule: No exact duration? Offer choices. Keep stated limits and intervals in the request.

cases.zh: 产品视频控制在30秒以内。
cases.en: Keep the product video at or under 30 seconds.

cases.zh: 这场培训按45分钟准备。
cases.en: Prepare this training session to last 45 minutes.

cases.zh: App开场那个动画，两秒就好。
cases.en: Make the App's opening animation two seconds long.

cases.zh: 这期访谈播客准备聊一个小时。
cases.en: Plan to talk for an hour in this interview podcast.

cases.zh: 帮我准备一段产品的 elevator pitch。
cases.en: Help me prepare an elevator pitch for the product.

cases.zh: 做个简短的口头自我介绍。
cases.en: Prepare a brief spoken self-introduction.

cases.zh: 这个视频的播放时间再长一点。
cases.en: Make this video's running time a little longer.

cases.zh: 这期播客想做长一点，慢慢聊。
cases.en: I'd like this podcast episode to be longer, with time to talk things through.

cases.zh: 这段讲解多留点时间，别匆匆带过。
cases.en: Allow more time for this explanation; don't rush through it.

cases.zh: 视频保持在一到两分钟之间。
cases.en: Keep the video between one and two minutes.

cases.zh: 简短一点。
cases.en: A bit shorter.

cases.zh: 这个压到30。
cases.en: Bring this down to 30.

cases.zh: 就用一两分钟那个。
cases.en: Use that one-to-two-minute one.

cases.zh: 这个拉长一点。
cases.en: Make this a little longer.

cases.zh: 按刚才那个时长。
cases.en: Use that duration from just now.

cases.zh: 让视频节奏轻快些。
cases.en: Give the video a livelier pace.

cases.zh: 这个内容是给领导快速过一遍的。
cases.en: This is for a quick review by management.

cases.zh: 我不想让听众觉得累。
cases.en: I do not want the audience to feel tired.

cases.zh: 这个App操作起来要利落。
cases.en: Make this App feel snappy to use.

cases.zh: 观众可能没耐心看完整个介绍。
cases.en: The audience may not have the patience to watch the whole introduction.

cases.zh: 把这篇稿子压到一千字。
cases.en: Shorten this draft to 1,000 Chinese characters.

cases.zh: 明天下午三点提醒我开会。
cases.en: Remind me about the meeting at 3 p.m. tomorrow.

cases.zh: 做10页的PPT。
cases.en: Make a 10-slide presentation.

cases.zh: 分析过去30天的订单。
cases.en: Analyze orders from the past 30 days.

cases.zh: 有个视频叫“三十秒演示”，把它加进来。
cases.en: Add the video called Thirty-Second Demo.

controls.name: Screenshot / Recording
controls.purpose: Capture a screen image or record on-screen actions as task references.
controls.rule: Start and stop recording explicitly. Confirming a capture and sending the task are separate actions.

cases.zh: 把屏幕上这块给你看看，帮我找找问题。
cases.en: Let me show you this part of the screen so you can help spot the problem.

cases.zh: 右上角这个报错，留张图给你分析。
cases.en: Keep an image of the error at the top right for you to analyze.

cases.zh: 我把登录步骤走一遍给你看，不用带我的声音。
cases.en: I will go through the login steps for you to see, without my voice.

cases.zh: 我操作一遍给你看，就这个窗口。
cases.en: I will walk through it for you in this window.

cases.zh: 把现在整个屏幕截下来，记录测试环境。
cases.en: Take a screenshot of the full screen to document the test environment.

cases.zh: 这张图表现在就在屏幕上，留个画面放进报告。
cases.en: This chart is on screen now. Save an image of it for the report.

cases.zh: 网页底部这块价格表，存成一张图给你参考。
cases.en: Save the pricing table at the bottom of the webpage as an image for reference.

cases.zh: 把我接下来拖动列表的过程存成视频，别开麦。
cases.en: Save my next drag-and-drop actions in the list as a video, with the microphone off.

cases.zh: 我边点这个窗口边讲，帮我留成一段带声音的视频。
cases.en: I will click through this window and explain it. Save the walkthrough as a video with my voice.

cases.zh: 我现在从搜索走到下单页，把这段屏幕操作存下来。
cases.en: I will go from search to the order page now. Save this sequence of screen actions.

cases.zh: 这块给你看看。
cases.en: Let me show you this part.

cases.zh: 把这个页面留下来。
cases.en: Keep a copy of this page.

cases.zh: 我操作一遍给你看。
cases.en: I will walk through it for you.

cases.zh: 刚才出错的过程能给你看一下吗？
cases.en: Can I show you what happened when it went wrong just now?

cases.zh: 屏幕上这段变化，你要看一张图还是整个过程？
cases.en: Would you like an image of this on-screen change or the whole sequence?

cases.zh: 现在这个页面排版挤在一起，想让你看到实际样子。
cases.en: The layout on this page is cramped. I want you to see how it actually looks.

cases.zh: 屏幕上这个弹窗的状态，靠文字实在说不清。
cases.en: I cannot explain the state of this on-screen dialog clearly in words.

cases.zh: 这个页面的动画只有动起来才看得出问题。
cases.en: The problem with this page's animation is only visible while it moves.

cases.zh: 我接下来会在App里重现那个卡顿，想让你看清整个过程。
cases.en: I will reproduce the lag in the App. I want you to see the whole sequence.

cases.zh: 刚才那个错误没留下视频，我能再操作一遍，想把问题说清。
cases.en: There is no video of that error. I can repeat the steps to make the problem clear.

cases.zh: 从相册加入昨天保存的截图。
cases.en: Add yesterday's saved screenshot from the gallery.

cases.zh: 我已经有昨天演示操作的视频，放在电脑桌面，帮我加进来。
cases.en: I already have yesterday's walkthrough video on my computer desktop. Add it here.

cases.zh: 把手机相册里已经录好的操作视频加进来。
cases.en: Add the walkthrough video already recorded in my phone's gallery.

cases.zh: 别留视频或图片，只用文字描述这段操作。
cases.en: Do not save a video or image. Just describe the steps in text.

cases.zh: 打开相机，录一下这台设备怎么转。
cases.en: Open the camera and record how this device rotates.

controls.name: Output Format
controls.purpose: Choose the file formats required for delivery.
controls.rule: Formats describe delivery requirements; choosing them does not create the output files.

cases.zh: 给我Word和PDF两个版本。
cases.en: Give me both Word and PDF versions.

cases.zh: 分析结果给我Excel，也留一份CSV。
cases.en: Give me the analysis in Excel and keep a CSV copy too.

cases.zh: 网页给我HTML文件，说明用Markdown。
cases.en: Give me the webpage as an HTML file and the guide in Markdown.

cases.zh: 汇报做成PPT，另外给个PDF。
cases.en: Make the presentation a PowerPoint and give me a PDF too.

cases.zh: 调研结论给我一份Word就行。
cases.en: A Word document is fine for the research findings.

cases.zh: 会议记录就用Markdown吧。
cases.en: Use Markdown for the meeting notes.

cases.zh: 海报最后给我PNG图片。
cases.en: Deliver the final poster as a PNG image.

cases.zh: 分镜清单给我做成Excel表。
cases.en: Put the shot list in an Excel spreadsheet for me.

cases.zh: App接口的字段清单给我CSV就好。
cases.en: A CSV is fine for the App's API field list.

cases.zh: 交互演示给我一个单页HTML文件。
cases.en: Give me the interactive demo as a single HTML file.

cases.zh: 给我能继续修改正文的版本。
cases.en: Give me a version whose text I can keep editing.

cases.zh: 整理成那个工具能用的样子。
cases.en: Put it into a form that tool can use.

cases.zh: 这个App给我可点击的版本。
cases.en: Give me a clickable version of this App.

cases.zh: 网页给我能自己部署的版本。
cases.en: Give me a version of the website I can deploy myself.

cases.zh: 给客户一个不用改、直接能看的版本。
cases.en: Give the client a version they can view without editing.

cases.zh: 整理好后发我就行。
cases.en: Just send it to me when it is ready.

cases.zh: 我想方便给同事看。
cases.en: I want an easy way to show it to colleagues.

cases.zh: 这个小程序之后还要继续做。
cases.en: I will keep working on this mini program later.

cases.zh: 这个本地工具要好用。
cases.en: Make this local tool easy to use.

cases.zh: 做完之后我还要拿去别处用。
cases.en: I will need to use it somewhere else when it is done.

cases.zh: 参考我上传的PDF。
cases.en: Refer to the PDF I uploaded.

cases.zh: 把报告里的“CSV”解释一下。
cases.en: Explain “CSV” in the report.

cases.zh: 从桌面打开PPT再分析。
cases.en: Open the PPT on the Desktop and analyze it.

cases.zh: 生成一张产品图，不用做文档。
cases.en: Generate a product image, not a document.

cases.zh: 读取这个JSON里的配置。
cases.en: Read the configuration in this JSON.

controls.name: Skills
controls.purpose: Choose available skills for the work the task requires.
controls.rule: Selecting skills records the task’s choices; it does not install or run them.

cases.zh: 用处理Word文档的技能整理这份报告。
cases.en: Use a Word document skill to organize this report.

cases.zh: 表格分析和做图表的技能一起用。
cases.en: Use the spreadsheet-analysis and chart-making skills together.

cases.zh: 用Frontend Design这个技能做网页App界面。
cases.en: Use the Frontend Design skill for the web App interface.

cases.zh: 刚才处理PDF的那个技能留着。
cases.en: Keep the PDF skill we just picked.

cases.zh: 安装一个网上找到的陌生技能。
cases.en: Install an unfamiliar skill found online.

cases.zh: 找个处理图片的技能，改一下产品图尺寸。
cases.en: Find an image-processing skill to resize the product photo.

cases.zh: 找个能做音频转写的技能。
cases.en: Choose a skill for audio transcription.

cases.zh: 用用户研究的技能整理下访谈主题。
cases.en: Use a user-research skill to organize the interview themes.

cases.zh: 代码审查和测试设计这两个技能都用上。
cases.en: Use both the code-review and test-design skills.

cases.zh: 选一个网页研究技能来比较竞品。
cases.en: Choose a web-research skill to compare competitors.

cases.zh: 用代码审查那个处理一下。
cases.en: Use that code-review one to handle this.

cases.zh: 用做界面的那个。
cases.en: Use the one for making interfaces.

cases.zh: 调用上次做报告的那组技能。
cases.en: Use the skill set from the last report.

cases.zh: 把刚才那组加上。
cases.en: Add that group from just now.

cases.zh: 就用音频转写那个。
cases.en: Use that audio-transcription one.

cases.zh: 把这份资料整理成汇报。
cases.en: Turn this material into a report for a meeting.

cases.zh: 这些数据太乱了，帮我处理一下。
cases.en: These data are messy; help me process them.

cases.zh: 这个App界面还需要完善。
cases.en: This App interface needs more work.

cases.zh: 帮我把这件事做得更好。
cases.en: Help me do this better.

cases.zh: 这份访谈内容我不知道从哪里整理。
cases.en: I do not know where to start organizing this interview.

cases.zh: 写一份员工技能培训计划。
cases.en: Write an employee skills-training plan.

cases.zh: 选择“文档专家”。
cases.en: Select Document Expert.

cases.zh: 不要调用额外技能，直接回答。
cases.en: Do not use extra skills; answer directly.

cases.zh: 根据这份员工技能表统计培训人数。
cases.en: Count the trainees using this employee skills table.

cases.zh: 在App里增加一个“技能”页面。
cases.en: Add a Skills page to the App.

controls.name: Color Palette
controls.purpose: Choose a coordinated color scheme for a page, poster, package or set of materials.
controls.rule: Use a palette to coordinate several elements; use Color to change one object.

cases.zh: App 用我上次存的那套配色。
cases.en: Use the palette I saved last time for the App.

cases.zh: 露营网站的颜色像森林那样自然，背景、文字和按钮一起搭一下。
cases.en: Give the camping site natural, forest-like colors; coordinate the background, text and buttons.

cases.en: Use the standard palette from the brand guide for the poster.

cases.en: Give the tech App a calm, futuristic mix of colors.

cases.zh: 亲子活动海报的颜色活泼一点，但别太刺眼。
cases.en: Make the family event poster’s colors lively, but not too bright.

cases.zh: 博物馆导览页的颜色，像旧纸和铜器那种感觉。
cases.en: Give the museum guide page colors that evoke aged paper and bronze.

cases.zh: 咖啡包装的几种颜色搭得温暖、朴素一点。
cases.en: Give the coffee packaging a warm, understated mix of colors.

cases.zh: 视频封面的颜色做出复古胶片的感觉。
cases.en: Give the video cover’s colors a vintage film feel.

cases.zh: 报告里这些图表的颜色柔和一点，放一起要协调。
cases.en: Soften the report charts’ colors and make them work together.

cases.zh: 小程序别用太多颜色，文字和按钮的颜色别抢。
cases.en: Keep the mini program’s colors restrained; text and buttons should not compete.

cases.zh: 这几块颜色再暖一点。
cases.en: Make the colors in these areas a little warmer.

cases.zh: 还是用上次那套颜色。
cases.en: Use that set of colors from last time again.

cases.zh: 整套颜色按品牌那版来。
cases.en: Use the brand’s version for the whole color scheme.

cases.zh: 这几个的颜色搭得协调一点。
cases.en: Make the colors of these elements work together better.

cases.zh: 这里想要莫兰迪那种配色。
cases.en: I want a muted Morandi-style palette here.

cases.zh: 生物科普网站，整体想要植物生长的感觉。
cases.en: Give the biology website an overall sense of plants and growth.

cases.zh: 科技展这套物料，要有未来感。
cases.en: Give this set of technology exhibition materials a futuristic feel.

cases.zh: 活动海报整体要热情、有活力。
cases.en: Make the event poster feel warm and energetic overall.

cases.zh: 海洋科普页面，想要清爽、宁静的感觉。
cases.en: Give the ocean education page a fresh, peaceful feel.

cases.zh: 婴儿护理页面，要有柔软、温和的感觉。
cases.en: Give the baby-care page a soft, gentle feel.

cases.zh: 只把标题换成深红色，其他颜色不动。
cases.en: Only change the title to deep red; leave the other colors unchanged.

cases.zh: 把文案里的“配色方案”翻译成英文。
cases.en: Translate the words “配色方案” into English.

cases.zh: 不要改配色，调整表格列宽。
cases.en: Keep the palette and adjust the table column widths.

cases.zh: 列出去年卖出的黑白两款产品。
cases.en: List sales of the black and white product variants last year.

cases.zh: 解释一下什么是互补配色。
cases.en: Explain what complementary colors are.

controls.name: Connectors
controls.purpose: Choose available external services for the task, such as document, data or messaging tools.

cases.en: Remove Feishu and use only Tencent Docs.

cases.en: Send this report through QQ Mail.

cases.en: Use those shared by the team.

cases.zh: 连接上次查项目数据的那个平台。
cases.en: Use the platform we used for project data last time.

cases.zh: 去团队那边查一下。
cases.en: Look it up on the team's side.

cases.zh: 把那个接进来。
cases.en: Bring that in.

cases.zh: 用上次查需求的那个。
cases.en: Use the one we looked up requirements with last time.

cases.zh: 资料散在好几个地方。
cases.en: The references are scattered across several places.

cases.zh: 这个报告需要更完整的信息。
cases.en: This report needs more complete information.

cases.en: I want to use the team's existing knowledge.

cases.zh: 帮我把不同地方的内容串起来。
cases.en: Help connect the information from different places.

cases.zh: 我希望这份方案能结合公司内部情况。

cases.zh: 设计一个飞书登录按钮的图标。

cases.en: Explain what a connector is in the document.

cases.zh: 只使用本地资料，不访问外部服务。
cases.en: Use only local references; do not access external services.

cases.en: Draw a diagram of a USB connector.
